description: This Java source file defines a PreferenceFragment class named CustomRestrictionsFragment, which manages custom application restrictions within an Android app. It demonstrates how to integrate app restriction settings with the restricted profile feature, maintaining state via shared preferences and restriction entries, and communicating restrictions back to the parent activity.

classes.name: CustomRestrictionsFragment
classes.description: A fragment that provides a user interface for setting custom app restrictions, including boolean, single-choice, and multi-choice preferences, and synchronizes these restrictions with the system.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes preferences, sets change listeners, and retains the fragment instance.

methods.name: onActivityCreated
methods.description: Retrieves existing restrictions, initializes preferences and restriction entries, and prepares the result intent to communicate restrictions back to the parent activity.

methods.name: onPreferenceChange
methods.description: Updates restriction entries based on user preferences and saves the updated restrictions into the intent for result communication.
